metadata.title: DataCareNext desktop-to-web parity matrix
metadata.freshnessBasis: Workspace is not a Git repository; evidence is current file content and generator execution time.

gates.extracted: Canonical source/schema/layout exists, or an explicit evidence gap is recorded.
gates.understood: Approved fields, focus/keys, validation, calculations, writes, reversal and report semantics exist.
gates.depth: Persists >=99% of the desktop write set with no unwritten desktop table, >=95% grid-column coverage and an approved contract. Breadth without depth is not parity.
gates.implemented: Complete reachable UI/API/DB/report/security/integration behavior exists; routes/models/generic renderers alone do not pass.
gates.tested: CI invokes real functions and dependencies across unit, invariant, integration, authorization, concurrency, migration and failure paths.
gates.desktop_compared: Scripted desktop and web workflows have zero/approved row, calculation, keyboard and visual/PDF differences.
gates.production_certified: Load, security, observability, backup/restore, DR, device/site UAT and business sign-off pass.

antiInflationRules: Headline state is the lowest unmet gate; gates are never averaged.
Parity percentage means only units with desktop_compared=passed.
No artifact means no gate credit.
Routes, pages, models, LOC, nav ready flags, builds and mock/unit tests are engineering progress only.
Critical invariants and financial forms independently block release regardless of aggregate counts.
The terms parity, pixel-exact, verified and certified require G5 artifacts for the relevant unit.

FIREBASE-SYNC.rationale: FireSharp is bundled but no extracted C# caller or Firebase data contract is evidenced.

SELENIUM-WHATSAPP.rationale: Meta Graph Cloud API replaces outbound messaging; local WhatsApp Web automation is waived.

externalInputsRequired: A reachable desktop SQL Server runtime containing sanitized representative shop data.
Read-only desktop source credentials in CUTOVER_SOURCE_* environment variables.
A matching migrated PostgreSQL target tenant in DATABASE_URL and G5_TARGET_TENANT.
G5_FORMS JSON identifying matching desktop and web vouchers for each form.

requirements.externalInputRequired: Production-like multi-instance deployment/network; representative sanitized shop data volume; approved traffic mix and latency/error/capacity targets; database sizing/pool budget.

requirements.externalInputRequired: Deployed HTTPS origin/proxy/WAF; trusted-proxy and distributed rate-limit design; CSP/HSTS/Permissions-Policy decisions; test roles; authorized independent assessor and window.

Production dashboards, alerts, retention, and on-call exercise

requirements.externalInputRequired: Backup store/vault and credentials; encryption/KMS and retention policy; secondary topology; production-sized encrypted snapshot; approved RPO/RTO; incident commander and recovery approver.

requirements.requirement: Device protocol validation and fallback design

requirements.externalInputRequired: Actual manufacturer/model/firmware/driver inventory; scale calibration/capacity/precision and USB/serial identity/settings; printer media/DPI; scanner mode; camera/browser; physical devices/workstation.
Named customer site; approved UAT tenant/build/data/control totals; module operators; supported workstations/browser; execution window.
e-Invoice GSP sandbox credentials/GSTIN; WhatsApp test number/token; SMS account/key/sender; live-rate account/key; approved recipients and reconciliation owner.

requirements.externalInputRequired: Completed passing G5/G6 evidence and named authorized operations, finance, inventory/manufacturing, and security/deployment signers with dated signatures and authority.

engineeringProgressNotParity.note: These counts must never be summed into parity or certification.

integrationReadiness.question: Which hardware and third-party integrations work now, and what is each one waiting for?
integrationReadiness.note: Every desktop device and third-party integration is implemented behind an env-driven transport, so no code change is needed when a scale, camera or credential arrives. The weighing-scale serial protocol is a faithful port of TR_TAG_OPBL.cs — CH340 at 9600/8-N-1 with a 2400/7-N-1 fallback, the 20-character digits-and-dot filter, three-decimal formatting, and the net-weight-cell focus condition, including the desktop's dropping of a minus sign. Readiness reports variable PRESENCE only, never values, and never marks an integration ready while a credential is missing: a fake transport succeeding proves nothing about a real one.

reportBaselines.question: Do the extracted Crystal layouts render reproducibly, and would a change be noticed?
reportBaselines.note: Baselines the whole extracted report surface, not the plan's 22 high-severity list: 21 of those are the .rpt files that were never supplied. Proves reproducible render/bind/positioning and catches engine or spec drift; does NOT prove pixel equality with desktop output, which needs the desktop runtime (G5).

behaviourTracing.question: Is every desktop validation enforced and every computed field accounted for?
behaviourTracing.note: Of the catalogued computed cells, more than half are SCREEN TOTALS: `mSG_TOT` mirrors the main grid's columns (`mSG_TOT.Cols = MSG.Cols`) and accumulates each column into row 0, so those cells are footer sums covered by the web's bill totals rather than per-line formulas. The per-line formulas are the real contract-review surface. Validations are keyed by their exact desktop message text, which is the only stable key between a decompiled MsgBox and a web guard; prompts and post-action notices are excluded from the denominator because they are not the API's responsibility. Calculations have no text key, so they are inventoried by resolved assignment target instead, and no coverage percentage is published for them: persisting a column is not proof the formula matches.

uiFieldAudit.question: Can an operator enter every field the API accepts?
uiFieldAudit.note: Complements the grid-column ratio, which is a lower bound because desktop gridColumns inventories include hidden state columns. A field the API accepts but no page can supply is uncapturable regardless of how many <th> elements exist.

depthScoreboard.question: Does the web persist what the desktop persists, and can every grid column be captured?
depthScoreboard.gridCaveat: Desktop gridColumns includes hidden state columns; treat grid coverage as a lower bound and columnCoveragePct as authoritative.

measurementSelfCheck.note: The generator fails if any declared business route is unclaimed or any claimed route is missing, so parity counts cannot drift silently.

summary.releaseDecision: NO-GO: zero units have desktop comparison or production certification; critical data/security/report/operations blockers remain open.
